batches.scope: Bounded-stack cleanup for very wide RomFS rebuilds, with host regression
batches.ps5_result: Maintainer reported build looked good on PS5; targeted wide-RomFS/TOTK UltraCam reproduction not exercised.
batches.ps5_game_regression: User retested Metroid Prime 4 on Batch 01 and pre-integration Switch UI Release build #37: same severe FPS slowdown. Neither migration change is necessary to reproduce it. Targeted RomFS scenario still untested.

batches.scope: Batch 02a: bounded texture-cache scan counting evictions rather than skipped-image visits, with fallback flag gc_scan=upstream. Pool memory, PS5 Pro and 4/6/8 GiB layout remain 02b.
batches.ps5_observation: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond, previously roughly 50-60 FPS, now frequently 7-20 FPS and only briefly 50 FPS; Zelda Breath of the Wild initial area near 30 FPS with a momentary 24 FPS and no visible texture corruption. Exact cause unconfirmed. Do not promote Batch 02a; verify old checkpoint A/B under matching Vulkan, resolution, mods and settings. Follow-up confirmed same severe Prime 4 slowdown on Batch 01 without collector backport. Therefore do NOT attribute this issue specifically to Batch 02a. Further comparison: identical Prime 4 slowdown occurs on pre-integration build #37, with neither Batch 01 nor Batch 02a present.
batches.diagnostic_toggle: gc_scan=upstream is compiled only when EDEN_DEV_PROFILE=ON; normal release ZIP does not read it. Do not suggest editing dev-settings.txt to test it on a normal build.

upstream_evidence.symptoms: ~60 FPS at ~9 GB memory and 2–9 FPS near ~12 GB; occasional crashes
upstream_evidence.maintainer_observation: Official v1.003.000 exhibits similar Metroid Prime 4 slowdown in user test on 2026-10-16.
upstream_evidence.caveat: User confirmed slowdown also on pre-integration Switch UI build #37 (v1.001-based) and upstream v1.003. Neither Batch 01 nor 02a is necessary to reproduce. 50-60 FPS earlier reference build/settings not yet established.
upstream_evidence.earlier_working_reference: Official original ProsperoEden, before v1.001.000 (user confirmation 2026-10-16), roughly 50–60 FPS. Exact version not yet known; native vs frame-generated FPS not determined.
upstream_evidence.next_comparison: Test official v1.000.110 vs v1.001.000 under identical Prime 4 game version/settings; both share Eden pin 67bada77 and 27 upstream commits separate them. This is a hypothesis test only.
upstream_evidence.public_beta_decision: Keep Prime 4 as separate baseline compatibility issue; do not attribute it to integration batches or claim a v1.000.110 success before testing.

next_baseline.result: Same severe Prime 4 slowdown seen as in batches 01 and 02a.
next_baseline.next: Identify older known-good app/game version, compare same scene and overlay memory metrics. Avoid attributing to integrated fixes.
